title: Start and stop scheduled sampling
goal: Use setInterval to schedule a repeating callback and then clear it with the saved timer number.
summary: After pressing "starts sampling", the device continues to write out sampling records. This round of sampling should end after pressing "stop sampling".
tasks: calls recordSample every 200ms in the start button event and saves the number returned by setInterval.
Give this number to clearInterval in the event of the stop button.
Observe the sampling records more than twice, and then click to stop. Keep written records and "Sampling has stopped" prompts after stopping.

example.note: Station screen refreshes every second. When the display ends, call stopRefreshing and pass the number saved at startup to clearInterval.

hint: Modifying the text and button status on the screen will only update the interface. When stopping repeated callbacks, clearInterval(timerId) needs to be called.
